To: Roman Purici <[contact omitted]>; Alina Terentii < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Roxana Teodorcic < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Follow-up info
Dear Roman and Alina,
I'm back with the information we talked about at the meeting today.
Please find attached:
- the infographic on Media Literacy course for 2023-2024 academic year, provided by IJC;
- recommendations of the media legislation working group on improving the draft project for National Media
Support Program. The link for tomorrow's meeting is: [opaque block]
I also leave here the link to the Internews report on Meta's collaboration through the Trusted Partner Program:
Safety at Stake: How to Save Meta's Trusted Partner Program - Information Saves Lives | Internews
If you have any questions, please let me know.
Best regards,
Oxana lutes | CoP at Internews in Moldova
